text:
katie: FYI CI turned red on macos build after protobuf bump. Failing to find generated header proto/foo.pb.h in: /workspace/build/gen

miguel: saw a couple failures in CI shards, can't repro locally yet

sam: mac-only? any error snippet?

katie: error:
```
In file included from src/main.cc:10:
src/third_party/foo/foo_wrapper.cc:3:10: fatal error: 'proto/foo.pb.h' file not found
#include "proto/foo.pb.h"
         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

katie: looks like CMake's generated files dir not added to include paths for the macos toolchain image

sam: try adding `target_include_directories(foo PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proto)` as quick patch

miguel: can we bisect the protobuf roll? suspect the cmake install path changed from libexec to lib

katie: requesting CI rerun + bisect. @buildcop can you kick a rerun of the failing mac shard?

buildcop: Rerun requested by @katie: https://ci.example/redwood/12345 (mac-shard-7)

ci-bot: Rerun finished — status: failed (mac-shard-7) — same missing header

sam: ok, I'll open a tiny PR adding fallback include dir and tag for fast rollback if needed

katie: thanks. if the bisect points to protobuf 3.21.5 -> 3.22.0 roll, we should hold that on darwin until we patch

miguel: assigning PR to @sam for now. I'll start bisect job on the protobuf roll commit range

sam: ping me when bisect has a narrower commit range. I'll add the change + macOS smoke test

katie: :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Note: tryjob triggered by miguel for bisect: https://ci.example/bisect/6789
